scope: Native force at a moving material point on both stick caps; v1 sphere results remain fixture-invalid history.

point.definition: Neutral upper thumbpad top center displaced in shell push direction by 0.5 thumbpad radius, projected onto that actual upper shell; point then fixed in stick local coordinates.
point.geometry_method: Select the actual stick shell with highest neutral shell-frame Z maximum as upper thumbpad. Use that shell XY bounding-box center and half X extent, excluding lower dome/stem; intersect only its top triangles along shell -Z at displaced XY.

criteria.fixture_rule: Hold tilt must remain at least1degree; invalid fixture gives null physics conclusion. Original low/positive/unload signal criteria are not changed.
criteria.unload_rule: Evaluate maximum public signal over the entire zero-load0.5s observe interval; also retain unload endpoint and final endpoint.

signals: Record unchanged public signal and unclipped q/travel; no threshold, hysteresis, latch or snapping.
visualization: One figure per force level with actual cap geometry, material point, horizontal/vertical force arrows and actual tilt trajectory; no sphere.
numerics: Existing approved discrete/Newton100/tolerance1e-8/refsafe disabled, 0.5ms x8; new-model click stop uses ruling2 approval; old model retains its original production parameters.
